note: Adams County park on Castle Rock Lake (Flowage), about 141 acres, with a sandy swim beach, boat launch and harbor. Mostly seasonal: about 61 of its 197 sites are sold by the night (the rest seasonal or yearly), and several of the nightly ones are walk-in tent sites. The lakeshore sites sit behind the park road. --Claude
summary: County reservation site read in full (197 site pages). 2027 $27/$35 + $10 res fee; year-round; reservations close 5 days out then FCFS; 30 A + water; rigs to 40 ft. Only ~61 of 197 sites sold nightly (59 seasonal, 71 yearly) - mostly seasonal caveat. Lakefront -> lakeview: the park loop road runs between every shore site and the water. Pin is in the campground; phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview. The Lakefront/Premium RV sites (nightly 89-95, ~43.9094,-89.9405; seasonal/yearly 21, 22, 126-133) all sit on the inland side of the paved park loop road, with a thin line of shore trees and the water ~20-35 m beyond the road (Esri zoom 19). Loop-road rule = view at best. The walk-in tent sites (1-17) near the water don't earn the value for a rig.
